name: Breaking the Breaker

angles.text: The defenders invoke the four winds to bless the hero after the cultists are stopped.
As a warrior, you face Commander Belguilos, a former peacekeeper feared as “the Breaker.”

faq.answer: Belguilos, called “the Breaker,” commands the cultist attack. Before joining the cult, she served as a peacekeeper, though those around her found her unsettling even then.
Commander Belguilos is at the villa at the base of the hill in the Gustberry Lowlands. From there, she coordinates the cultist assault on the local defenders.
faq.q: Where can Commander Belguilos be found?

faq.answer: The cultists’ onslaught is nearly impossible to repel while Belguilos directs it. Eliminating her breaks the cult’s leadership and gives the defenders a real chance to survive.
Before the cult’s influence spread beyond control, Belguilos served as a peacekeeper. Those who knew her found something deeply unsettling in her even then.
faq.q: What was Belguilos's past before joining the cult?

aliases: who says four winds bless you
faq.answer: The blessing of the four winds is an expression of profound relief and gratitude among the defenders after the terrifying cult commander has been permanently stopped.
faq.q: What is the significance of the blessing of the four winds?

faq.answer: The Gustberry Lowlands are contested ground where the cult assault unfolds. Commander Belguilos can be found at a villa at the base of the hill.

sections.body:
Cultists assault the Gustberry Lowlands, driving the local defenders to the brink. Repelling them seems nearly impossible while Commander Belguilos directs the attack. All fear her as “the Breaker.”

Her villa is the operation’s base. Slaying her there is perilous, near-suicidal, yet passivity leaves the defenders doomed.
sections.title: A Desperate Defense

sections.body: Before she commanded the cultists, Belguilos kept order as a peacekeeper. Even then, those around her found something deeply unsettling in her manner. When the cult’s influence spread beyond control, she embraced its extremism. Now she commands the cultists and is a terror.
sections.title: The Fallen Peacekeeper

summary: In the Gustberry Lowlands, cultists press the defenders hard. Commander Belguilos leads the assault from her hillside villa, and striking her there may be the defenders’ only chance to survive.
attribution: In-game quest text: Breaking the Breaker
